format_type.description: The PLY format variant: ascii, binary_little_endian, or binary_big_endian.

comments.description: A list of comment strings to include in the header.

vertices.description: Configuration for vertex elements in the PLY file. Each item defines a batch of vertices with common properties and their data.

vertices.items.description: Placeholder type for the list items. The actual structure is inferred by the template logic expecting a map with count, has_normals, has_colors, and data.

faces.description: Configuration for face elements in the PLY file. Each item defines a batch of faces with their vertex indices.

faces.items.description: Placeholder type for the list items. The actual structure is inferred by the template logic expecting a map with count and data.
